balls.text: The Jamaican keeps it full. The Trinidadian is unperturbed. He stays back in the crease, crunches the bat down in a wild arc, so typically Caribbean, and carts him flamboyantly over long-on. He doesn't smile. The Jamaican doesn't frown. Got to love the West Indians! Chennai have 205.
Bangalore were keeping their best for the last over. Raina goes now, another full ball from the Jamaican sneaks past the big mow over the leg side and disturbs the furniture. On a hat-trick.

and gone. Gayle has bowled a really top over here, and Morkel's inability to do anything with balls that is not in his zone comes to the fore. Full ball, he jumps out and carves straight to long off on the circle.
another super yorker, Morkel's looking for an inch, Gayle's refusing to give him any. Another ball feebly hit back to the bowler.
yorkel Morkel. He can't get under a really full ball on leg stump. Mistimes the drive back down the track.
full on off stump, Raina hits it hard but straight to cover. Single taken.

Morkel gets a short ball too, and drags the pull shot away through midwicket. Raina hurries through and Morkel responds for the second. The batsmen may be different, but the running remains just as good.
another short ball, this time Raina mistimes the pull to an untenanted wide long-on area for a single.

we have seen a few sixes today, and I dare say this was the best. Raina knows another short ball may be round the corner, so you think he is going to be a little late to move forward when Aravind pitches it up outside off. Nothing like it. Raina reaches out, gets outside the line and bangs it over extra cover, on the up, inside out. That hardly took off, but easily cleared the rope.
another bouncer, this time too short and it is called a wide.

short ball straight away, and nearly a hat-trick for the team. Raina doesn't like these short balls, he hangs back in the crease and taps the pull to square leg. He wanted one, Morkel didn't and Vettori misses with Raina well out.
wickets are like London buses for Bangalore. None come for hours on end, and suddenly two in quick succession. Dhoni gets a juicy full toss outside off and smashes it straight to long-on.

tomorrow morning, Vijay will wake up and kick himself for giving away a century that was there for the taking. But for a man who has been barely able to stand on his feet for the last 30 minutes or so, 95 is not bad at all. That too in a final. Aravind keeps it full and outside off, Vijay looks to go big over the off side but toe-ends it to cover inside the circle. End of a stunningly sublime innings.

see you later Alligator. Dhoni has waited for the length ball since the first ball of this over, and here it comes. Dhoni gets under it with the joy of a child unwrapping Christmas presents. And sends it into the Chennai night sky.

Gayle's bowled superbly after that first ball. This is a superfast yorker on the pads, and Dhoni nudges to the leg side. He wants two, Vijay is in no position to make it, but the throw is to the wrong end.
again spears it on leg stump as Vijay looks to move and heave. Runs away off the pad to the leg side.
Vijay attempts a reverse sweep, Gayle smartly slips it down the leg side and Vijay can't do anything. Not a wide, and I think rightly so. George Binoy agrees. Sriram Veera disagrees.
fuller and wider of off stump, Dhoni whacks it to long-on for one.
the opposite of the yorker. A hopelessly short ball that stands up at Dhoni, who seemed beside himself with intent before clobbering it over deep square leg.
short ball at 133 kph, Vijay seems to have all the time he needs today. He waits and pulls between midwicket and deep square leg, and has enough time to come back for the second.
low full toss outside off, Dhoni bottom hands the cover drive to the sweeper in the deep.
three in a row. Knuckle ball at 122 kph, Dhoni swings hard well before the ball comes along, and misses.
smart from Zaheer, produces two dot balls on the trot. Very wide yorker outside off, Dhoni can't reach it and it is just short of being called wide.
fuller this time and angling in outside off, Dhoni attempts the lap scoop, not a shot he tries too often, and doesn't make contact.
short ball angling into MS, who stays back in the crease and carves through the covers for a couple.
Vijay jumps out again, gets too close to the pitch and dead bats it. If he hadn't, would have been stumped by miles. He's too tired to contemplate getting back into the crease.
Dhoni pushes quietly with the spin through long-on for one more single
too full and straight from Vettori, Vijay works it away square for one more.
very full on off stump and Dhoni drives with the turn into the covers for another single.
Vijay pushes into the leg side for one more. He is completely knackered. Eight more for a ton. That should keep him going.
another couple. Short ball on the hips, Vijay goes back and places it carefully and softly to deep midwicket for two more. He can barely run now, but had enough time now.
Dhoni begins with ... you guessed right - the theme of the day - two. Short ball, turning away, and he cuts gently into the gap in front of point.

this time, the overthrow works for Bangalore. If Dhoni's arrival to the crease at this point in the game can be termed a victory. Hussey looks to launch Syed's full fare with the spin over the leg side, and after a long time he mis-hits one. Gayle at long-on holds on. Bangalore have a wicket. Surprise surprise. Ends a record first wicket stand in all IPL games.

run out appeal, referred, but Vijay seems in. He works Syed through midwicket and Hussey hustles him to come in for the second. Vijay makes it, and will be happy that it is referred. Gives him a breather. Overthrow taken, by the way.

now that shot, he's played just like his captain would have. Syed throws it well up on middle and off, not many batsmen would manage to get under such balls. You need to stay right back and generate bat speed from well behind, with strong wrists. Vijay did just that and whiplashed it over long-on.
150 up. Ouch. Hussey comes down again, it is a full toss and he steers through the covers for one more.
Hussey has hit Syed into the Marina Beach. Wallop. Smear. Visceral. He charges out, Syed dares him by throwing it well up and Hussey puts him on the Chidambaram Stadium roof.
Vijay plays the first dot ball since Syed failed to hold on to a tough return chance. He looks to swing Vettori through the leg side, but is early into the shot as Vettori slows it up.
Hussey works Vettori with the spin for a change, through midwicket for one more.
another reverse sweep, this time not as graceful, a lazy effort in the deep gives Hussey two more.

Mr Cricket has fifty. And he brings it up with such a lovely reverse sweep, you want to gift it to the woman of your dreams. Full from Vettori on off stump, Hussey swaps the grip even as he lunges out, cuts out all the risk and slaps it through third man. Easy as.
moves away again, this time Vettori follows him with a short ball and Vijay mistimes a pull over the infield. That kind of night.
inside out, easy as you like. Vijay advances down the track and opens up the off side, and then puts the wrists into work to scatter Vettori through cover point.
Vijay quietly tucks a length ball through square leg for one. The batsmen are tired and ask for the time-out at the first opportunity. The smarts.
Hussey moves to 49, he's feeling knackered too.. The weather's getting to them. Hussey charges out, and drags Zaheer around towards midwicket for one more.
short of a length this time, from round the stumps and looking to handcuff Vijay, but he manages to work it to short fine leg for one more.
on the pads, Vijay gets it away into the leg side for a couple more.

Bangalore have still not woken up. Short of a length outside off stump, Vijay moves into position and steers with a smartly opened face, perfectly in between point and short third. The former reacts slowly, and the latter almost doesn't react. Four more.
starts off with a bouncer that cuts all the room as Hussey motors out of his crease. He ends up guiding a slapped pull to short fine leg, and they get the single.

this is slaughter, and Aravind the lamb is walking into it. He's serving up freebies in Vijay's hitting arc and Vijay's swinging away without a fuss. Another short of length ball that comes in and sits up like an early Christmas gift. Vijay smacks it off the front foot over midwicket. This is too easy to be true for Vijay.
on the Huss' pads and he works it through square leg for one more.
on the pads, Aravind is all over the place in this over. Vijay whips through midwicket, and thankfully for RCB they have protection there.
this time he goes off side, lofting him cheekily over the infield for two more.

with his short hair cut, unkempt stubble and similar build, Vijay does remind me of Dhoni. He's hitting sixes just as well as that man, today, but with a little more finesse. Length from Aravind. Poor, poor length. Vijay reaches out and deposits him well over cow corner.
short ball, slips well down the leg side. Wide, almost on two counts.

Hussey survives a run-out. Very full on the pads from Aravind, Hussey blocks it and finds Vijay is almost at his end. He responds late, but was not even in the frame as Aravind collected in his follow through and tried to hit the stumps at the bowler's end. Miss. Kohli, backing up, could not get around soon enough.
yorks Vijay on leg stump and he works it away through midwicket. They get two more. Don't ask me how.

dropped, but if he had held on it would have been the catch of the tournament. Very full and on middle, Vijay whips it back really hard and Syed has to arrest his follow through and dive rapidly to the right as the ball shoots along very low. He gets a hand to it, but the ball hits turf immediately after.
another full toss, this time Hussey hauls it wide of midwicket for one.
another full toss, Syed thinks he is safe if he keeps it well wide of off stump. He needs to think again. Hussey leans across and carves it through extra cover and Tiwary at long off has no chance.
full toss outside off. Not a wise option to a man who is hitting it like Vijay has been. This time, he quietly drives down to long on for a single. 50 up. Well played!
full and well wide of off stump, Hussey whips it down the ground for a single
full ball to finish the over, Hussey pushes into extra-cover without a fuss for one more.
shortens the length at normal pace, Vijay stays back and taps it towardsmid-off for one more.

Chennai are taking this away. Gayle will have a lot of work to do later. Slower ball, too full and too easy to spot. Vijay walks into position and gracefully caresses it over extra cover for four more.

lazy shot, but Vijay survives. It is full and on the stumps, he tries to hang back in the crease and thump it hard straight down the ground. Gets a thick under edge away. No run taken, pardon the scoring glitch earlier.

they dropped catches off Chennai in the final of IPL 2010. They have dropped catches off Chennai in IPL 2011. And they are still doing it in the final. Length ball, angles into Vijay who helps it along over midwicket. Ended up timing the lofted chip better than he wanted, and Pomersbach was patrolling the fence. He ran back and tried to take it, but it slipped through. No cool hand, Luke.
nice bouncer, caught Vijay unawares and he chose to let it go just outside off.
good response, Vettori throws it right up in the blockhole and Vijay has to dig it out to the point area. They still get a single.

another six. Vijay almost inevitably dances out of his castle, and this time late enough to ensure Vettori can't see him and change plan. The ball lands in the swinging zone this time and Vijay obliges with the sort of shot that would make Ernie Els proud. Retrieve it from long-on
another full ball, Hussey forces it off the bottom hand through midwicket for one more.
yorks him but well outside leg as Hussey misses the sweep. Appeals for lbw, correctly turned down.
Vijay chips out, gets too close to the pitch and drives to long-on for one more.
back of a length on the pads, Vijay whips it towards midwicket. I have run out of words to describe how fast they run, so I'll just stick to saying that they have somehow got two. Again.

good start to Mithun's over, not the best finish though. Hussey opens the face daintily and guides him to third man. Once it goes outside the circle, these batsmen are looking at a minimum of two. Every time.
first four of the match! Bumper at 135 kph, Hussey has a year or so to play the shot, and he waits and waits after getting into position. And then he unfurls a cracking pull.

interesting shot, even more interesting fielding. Hussey charges out, and chips Mithun right over his head and very straight. Mayank moves across swiftly from long-off and swoops in on the ball, a couple of feet in front of the boundary, and parries it over to long-on who throws it back.
short of a length and coming in, CSK seem to be playing within themselves here. Vijay drives to long-on for an easy single
fuller from Mithun, Hussey forces it into the covers and settles for the single this time.
another couple taken, this must be driving Vettori mad. Short of a length outside off, Hussey stays back and dabs through backward point. Some serious sprinting between the wickets happening here.
aha, Vijay advances and Vettori flattens the trajectory. Vijay is in no man's land and does well to force it back to the bowler though he wasn't to the pitch of the ball. Good start from Dan.
they are playing him watchfully here. And well, they have run another improbable couple. Tossed up and curving in, Vijay taps it softly to long-on and they charge up and down, these guys.
Hussey stays back in the crease and works Vettori with the spin through square leg.
lovely drifting, curling ball that swims in and lands in front of middle and off as Vijay pokes a little uncertainly. Single takes to the leg side in the end.
on the pads this time, Hussey nudges through square leg for a single.
tossed up on off stump and Hussey drives it back to the bowler.
drifts onto the pads this time, and Hussey nudges to square leg for a single. Bangalore promptly take the time-out. They need to come up with better plans.
fuller on off stump, Hussey drives to mid-on with the spin.
beats him outside off with some extra spin, Hussey was looking to steer and the ball broke away sharply
surprises everyone with a beamer almost, and Vijay pushes into the off side for a single
holds it back a touch, Vijay quietly defends.

everytime one of these guys hits a six, the other one responds with a bigger one. Vijay bounds out to Gayle this time, it is a ball with rare flight from Gayle and he thumps it over wide long-on. Four sixes, no fours yet tonight.

Mr. Cricket jumps out in a flash, his feet a whir of precision that get exactly to the pitch of Syed's delivery angled in towards middle. A nice clean swing of the blade ensues and the ball sails into the stand at midwicket.
shortens the length this time, Hussey leans out and defends.
good start from Syed, he's keeping it tight and Chennai are dealing in unbelievably well-run twos here. Hussey chisels a nudge through the square leg area and Vijay responds for two more.
on Vijay's pads, he calmly taps it into the largely vacant areas in front of square inside the circle on the leg side.
again Syed flights it from round the wicket and Hussey guides it wide of mid-on for one more.
tossed up on the pads, Hussey whips through midwicket and almost inevitable they steal a couple.
speared into the pads, typically economical over from Gayle, the overthrows excluded. Hussey looks to work it around towards square leg and they get a single.
Vijay chops it away through point for one more single

wake up Bangalore! Can't keep giving overthrows away in a final. Gayle tosses it up on leg stump and Hussey misses as he looks to flick. The ball runs away to the off side as Gayle appeals. Hussey charges down the track, and Tiwary hurls it at the non-striker's end and misses. Four freebies.
tossed up again from over the wicket to Vijay who works it off the pads with the spin for one more
turn on offer, that comes in from round the wicket, grips and goes away. Hussey guides it off the outer half towards short third man for one
tossed up slowly on off stump, Vijay reaches out and works it down the track for one.
decent finish to the over. Zaheer finishes with one on the channel outside off and Hussey steers towards point.
one again the Huss tries to hustle his nemesis by charging out of the crease. Again, can't generate room or length and he ends up working it towards mid-on for no run
fullish ball outside off, Vijay leans into a nice straight drive and doesn't over-hit it. Gets only the single though.
Vijay's looking really good here. Back of a length ball angles into the pads, and he easily works it around through square leg for two more.
another needless throw. Hussey nudges off the backfoot towards point and prances across. Syed Mohammad comes in and hurls it at the non-striker's end. No damage this time.

Hussey joins the fun now. Zaheer lands one short and angling down the leg side. Hussey easily moves inside the line and swings it all the way over deep backward square leg. CSK are up and away. And I wonder if Kohli's overthrow had a role to play in it.

that's a shot Vijay can play in his sleep. That's a shot you can wake up from your sleep to watch. Short of a length ball, the kind coaches advice you to bowl. Can't drive, can't pull. Unless you are Vijay. He just reaches a foot across and then wallops it off the front foot emphatically in front of midwicket.
short of a length and angling across Vijay who is decisively forward and pushes into the covers.
quietly nudges the single this time, Hussey stays back and pushes towards mid-on for one.
perilously close to thew off stump as Aravind gets one to hold the line outside off stump and Hussey feels for it just inside the line.

some trademark Vijay timing on that, and there are two yellow-shirted gazelles sprinting between the wickets. Short of a length angling in gently, Vijay stays back in the crease and whips it off the back foot wide of mid on. How did they pick up three there? Superb running.

short of a length and wide of off stump, Hussey mistimes the cut straight to Kohli at point. Kohli needlessly throws at the bowler's end, with Vijay not looking for a single at all. Overthrow conceded.

aha, interesting shot. Hussey jumps out, ends up getting too close to the ball, and yet times it well to the left of Tiwary at mid-off who moves with unbecoming agility to tumble away and stop. Single taken
this one is back of a length outside Hussey's off stump and he lets it go.
Vijay again leans across with authority and punches wide of mid-off for a single.
better from Vijay, moves nicely into a check drive as Zaheer again angles it across him

Vijay edges straight away, and runs like a hare. Zaheer angles it across gently, Vijay's feet move lazily into the shot and briskly thereafter. The ball screams away to third man and he rushes back for the second. Wide throw helps his cause.
on the pads from over the wicket, Hussey is away nudging through square leg.

A lot has changed since last year. Lalit Modi is gone. Two new teams have come in. The off-field excesses have been reduced. The on-field excesses have increased. One thing, however, hasn't changed. A virtually unchanged Chennai Super Kings side retains the IPL. MS Dhoni walks on water. Backwards. Blind-folded. On a tight-rope. And oh yeah, Tiwary launches the last ball over extra cover for a six. Too little. Far too late. No one even noticed. The fireworks erupt in Chepauk. Whistle podu!
Syed works a single off the penultimate ball, pushing the length ball into the midwicket region.
played with the spin into the off side, and a single for Tiwary.
short of a length and straightening, he plays it off the back foot into the off side.
tossed up outside off, Tiwary gets under this one and slugs it over long-off.
short ball, played away into the off side for a single.
another short ball, another mistimed pull. Single to deep midwicket.
again cramping him as it comes in, Syed nudges to midwicket and gets a single.
bounces hustles Syed as it goes down the leg side.
finally someone holds on, it is Mr. Cricket sweeping in the deep cover region. Short ball outside off, he goes for the cut and carves it into Hussey's lap. Start the autorickshaw!
nasty. Bollinger gives him a vicious bouncer, Zaheer goes for the pull and ends up working it onto his helmet grill. Clunking clatter.

another drop in the deep. CSK are finally dropping their guard. Zaheer looks to hoist Bollinger over long off, and Mukund, subbing for Vijay, was running in. He should have held on low, but he spilt it.
full ball outside off, Tiwary thumps it hard but straight to long off

as comical as they come. Tiwary looks to slug over the leg side, mis-hits the ball, loses his grip on the bat and the willow nearly travels further than the leather. Always a poor sign that, for a batsman.
Zaheer advances, takes it on the full and whips to deep midwicket
short ball, breaks away as Zaheer looks to cut and he mistimes to cover.
and he gets him down the ground again, jabbing a short ball over the bowler's head and Ashwin reacts slowly to allow four more.
Zaheer can't connect with the big hit this time.

fair to say I put the commentator jinx on Ashwin, he's produced the first Chennai blemish today. Fair to say it has come 3 hours too late for Bangalore. Zaheer lofts a length ball straight down the ground, Ashwin moves across from long-off and drops it as he lunges and skids sideways
this time he looks to slog him with the turn, but the ball turns too much and he mistimes.
Zaheer can't deal with one that fizzes past him outside off stump.
now he gets the single, working with the spin through the covers.
sharp offspinner again, Tiwary stays back and looks to work it around but can't get it away.
tight lines and breaking in nicely, Zaheer manages to squeeze it down to third man.
short and breaking away big, Tiwary cuts into the covers for a single
lovely bowling. Slow loopy bouncer, Zaheer looks to pull and misses.
slower ball outside off from round the stumps, Zaheer doesn't pick it and misses as he looks to cut.
length ball again, but straighter and Zaheer lofts over the infield for a couple
Zaheer backs away, opens up the off side and carves Bollinger through the covers. The RCB anthem plays on the PA system. Pretty pointless.
short to Tiwary, he pulls so late that the ball goes wide of mid-off. Without any timing on it.,
short ball to his fellow left-arm seamer, who pulls in ungainly style to midwicket.

never bet against the law of averages. You thought Tiwary wouldn't time a single ball today. You were SO wrong. He's roundhouse kicked a fullish length ball angling into him, comfortably over long-on. Rare six.
fullish and tailing in towards leg stump, worked without timing into the midwicket region.
another slower ball, Tiwary throws everything at it and it dribbles into the deep cover area.
another Bravo special slower ball, Tiwary is not even bothering to spot them anymore, he is just swinging at them regardless. Outside edge this time, whimpers away to third man.
slower ball, Zaheer somehow manages to get bat on it after being foxed, and he gets a single to fine leg.
full delivery outside off from Bravo, Tiwary guides without intent through point
another dot ball, Zaheer stays in the crease and can't get it away.
Zak stays stuck on the back foot and can't push the ball away.
this time he gets the single, laboriously pushing a ball in front of square. Surely Mr. Mallya could have done better with that $1.6 mil
Tiwary looks to slog heave Jakati's length ball over midwicket, and is so late on the shot that he ends up deciding to defend it.
armer outside off, Zaheer edges off the back foot to short third man.
Jakati skids one across mis-timer Tiwary who squeezes it away past point.
Mithun swats a short ball straight to Bollinger at long-on. The fat lady's throat is clear, and the auto-rickshaw meters are being reset.
now he gets bat on it, and lofts a single wide of mid-off.
at some point, the law of averages is going to catch up with Tiwary and he is going to connect with the ball. Until then he will keep swinging and missing like this.
Tiwary gets a thick outside edge this time, and the ball runs away to deep backward point.
another slowish ball, the variation is wasted on someone as cluelessly out of form as Tiwary. Swish and a miss.
slow offcutter to start off, full and on the pads, Mithun somehow gets to the other end.
some relief for Tiwary, he makes decent connection with one of those cut shots as Raina drops short. Four through backward point.
Tiwary is completely stuck. Looks to dab through the off side but can't get it away.
keeps it tight outside off, and Mithun steers through point for a single.

for those of you who were wondering, yes, Bravo does miss the occasional save in the deep. Mithun gets under a fullish ball and swats it high towards midwicket. Bravo should have stopped it, running across to his left, but missed.
Raina does his impersonation of Muralitharan. Big turning offbreak, comes in huge and Mithun is utterly clueless. Landed on off and middle, but missed leg.
a boundary after a long time. Short ball outside off, cut away through backward point for four.
Mithun forces a single down to long on.
this time he gets the single away, steering past point for a single.
half an appeal as Tiwary stays on the crease and plays all over a sharp offbreak.
chinaman from Jakati, legbreak from Ashwin, is there anything these spinners can't do? Full on off stump, the batsman is really late to dig it out.

this final has lost more fizz than yesterday's beer can that was accidentally left open. Vettori goes for a blob, a tame leading edge back to Ashwin as he looks to work an offbreak to the leg side. Vettori looks sheepish and gutted at the same time.
Tiwary chips him with the spin over wide mid-off for a single.

the future of Indian batting falls to the future of Indian batting. This is the Indian Premier League after all. Raina slips a sharp offbreak past Kohli's attempted turn to the leg side, and catches him plumb in front. That one straightened in enough after landing on leg. Chennai Super Kings have one hand on the glittering trophy.
he finally gets under one and lofts down the ground for a couple. Raina was turning the other way when the throw came in from Ashwin, and it hit him on the back side
Raina's tying him up. Full and flat on leg stump, Tiwary bunts to the leg side and looks for another single. Not there.
this one skids along, Tiwary is late to go back and then doesn't get it too far away to the off side. No single taken.
tossed up now on the stumps, Tiwary steers to point and nearly runs himself out. Chennai are fielding superbly here.
short again from Raina, Kohli pulls hard and Badri at midwicket does well to stop it, but fumbles to allow a single.
short ball again, Kohli bunts another single and it is time for a two-minute breather while the sponsors make money with their ads on TV.
direct hit, referred to the third umpire, but Tiwary is well in. Worked off the back foot towards midwicket, and they come back for two. Tiwary has enough time to return.
this time he lands the regulation ball on middle and leg, it is worked to the leg side for a single
aha, Jakati tries another Chinaman, and loses it completely. High full toss well outside off, and it is called a wide.

Bangalore are losing gas too fast here. Jakati nails another one, he's taken some memorable return catches this IPL, and this was one of the easier ones. Full ball on the pads, it was a chinaman out of no where! Luke leans across and looks to whip but he seemed to get a hint of leading edge as he played to back to the left of Jakati who jumped across easily to hold it.
tossed well up on middle and leg, Kohli leans out and opens the face to steer through point
full length ball outside off, Luke carefully works it through mid-on for one.
two to end the over, Kohli whips Raina with the turn softly enough to give him time to come back
three in three, Kohli again works a full ball straight to wide mid-on.
cover's turn now, intercepts swiftly as Kohli looks for a single through cover.
nice work from midwicket, moves in quickly and cuts off the ball as Kohli works off the pads.
fuller this time, Kohli works him with the spin through midwicket for a couple

and Kohli has muscled him for six through cow corner. Only just. Really short ball, Kohli pounces on it and swings it over midwicket. Bravo was lurking in the deep and leapt high to try and haul it in, but the ball was around 2 feet further up.
short ball, but not too short and Kohli punches down past mid-on for a single
generously full outside Kohli's off stump and he drives it back to the bowler.
full on the pads, Luke whips through square leg for one.

very strange end to AB's innings, and he isn't happy. Not sure why, he is dead plumb. He was hustling this way and that in the crease before the ball came. He first went away to the leg side, then started coming back towards middle, and Jakati landed it short of a length on off. AB was late on the pull after all the fancy footwork, and missed. Hit in front of off, hitting off and middle three-fourths of the way up.
very full on leg stump, AB defends from the crease.
short ball turning away, cut away in front of point for a single.
back of a length again, Kohli forces it off the inner half towards midwicket for a single.
slow bouncer this time, only 119 kph and Kohli is completely foxed. It comes after he plays the pull.
short again, Kohli moves into the pull and gets it down to deep backward square leg for a couple.
cover has gone back, and just as well. AB cuts well through the covers and is restricted to a single this time.

three fours in three balls for AB. Nothing bowling from Morkel, trundles in and serves it up on a juicy length nicely outside off. AB reaches out and thumps it over the infield and into the cover fence.
another short of length ball on the pads, Kohli works it along to square leg.
even better. AB scrambles Bollinger's patent lengths by moving rapidly across the stumps and then lap-heaves a short ball on his hips over short fine leg for four.
some AB class coming through in that shot. Bollinger over-pitches at 129 kph and AB caresses it through the line to send it speeding into the covers. Top shot.
this time he stands back in the crease and taps towards the off side for a single
exemplary pull from Kohli. He was early into position, got the wrists over it and kept it down. Not timed too well, but he did everything else perfectly
another quick bouncer, hurries into AB who is late on the pull and just manages to get it away square for one.

starts with a nice hustling bouncer, and AB has to arch his back away to make room and steer. Point and cover, Raina and Badri, both want to field it. Both dive across. Chennai look like they want this bad.
Bangalore are sleep-walking here. Time to wake up. Back of a length ball outside off, Kohli steers without intent to point.
length ball on off stump, quietly pushed into the mid-off region for a single.
AB nearly top-edges the bouncer to deep square leg. He is early into the shot and spoons it up with such poor timing that it doesn't carry.
Morkel tucks AB up with a short of length ball, and it is worked ooff the pads to square leg. Needless throw at the bowler's end, this time it hits the stumps and there are no overthrows

Bravo! over-pitched on the pads, it is flicked really well through square leg but Bravo thinks he can stop it. He puts in a huge scramble and dive to stop it, but it is still running away from him as he skids along side the ball. And then, he has a second go at it, while ensuring he's not touching the rope. Superbly done.
back of a length around off stump, Kohli reaches half across and defends to the leg side
works him with the spin this time, and gets a single through midwicket.
big offspinner, and his action is almost the same for this and the skidder. Kohli spots the turn late as it comes in, and misses the cut comfortably.
short ball outside off, he looks to cut and plays straight to point.

the carom comes into play, and Mayank deals with it like someone who's never seen it before. Lands on middle, grips and breaks away past a tame attempt at the cut. The bat isn't in the way, but the off stump is. Ashwin has put Chennai completely in control here.
miscued but safe. Ashwin slows it up and flights on the off stump, Kohli looks to heave over the leg side and the inside edge goes away from midwicket.
fullish ball on the pads, worked quietly to square leg.
short again, straight again, Kohli skips inside the line and nudges to square leg for a single.
Kohli rides the tennis-ball bounce and nudges off the hips through square leg. A couple of runs taken.
length ball angling in towards the stumps, and Kohli pushes it to mid-on
another short ball pushed down the leg side, and this time Mayank glances the pull fine. Dhoni does well to dive away and get a glove in the way to slow it down.
poor ball, short and angling into Mayank's hips and he works it along to fine leg for his second boundary.
he begins with one angling into the pads and Kohli pushes a single through mid-on.
was that a legbreak? George Binoy thinks so. Goes awry in any case, well wide of off stump and Mayank cracks it through point for four.
Kohli looks to push one backward of square and they get a leg bye as he misses.

it took Ashwin three balls. He was Chennai's weapon against Bangalore's weapon in the last game too. And he was once again. What a classic set-up. What lovely bowling. Take a bow, Ashwin. He's set him up with the last two offbreaks, and this time he focused on getting one to skid in. He went round arm and slung it in, Gayle spotted the change in pace and trajectory late and by then he had committed himself into the cut. Thin outside edge, Dhoni does the rest. Have CSK got the one wicket they needed? Ashwin does his version of the aeroplane. What a comeback after being smashed on the head in the last game.
sharp spin again, this time closer to Gayle, forcing him to play and he feels for it inside the line. Gayle looks a little unruffled.
BIG turn. Short of a length outside off, lands and goes away a mile. Gayle leaves.
sprightly length ball on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to the leg side.
